app.name: Tazko
signin.title: Sign in to Tazko
signin.lead: Use the Google account your administrator invited. Workspace and personal accounts both work.
signin.note: Access is by invitation only. If you cannot sign in, ask your company owner to invite your email address.
signin.error.expired: The sign-in took too long or was started in another tab. Please try again.
signin.error.failed: Google sign-in did not complete. Please try again.
refused.title: This account is not invited
refused.lead: {email} is not on the list for Tazko.
refused.lead.unknown: This Google account is not on the list for Tazko.
refused.note.not_invited: Ask the owner of your company to invite this exact email address, then sign in again. If you meant to use a different Google account, choose it below.
refused.note.email_not_verified: Google has not verified this email address. Verify it with Google, or choose a different account below.
refused.note.disabled: This account has been turned off. Ask your administrator to turn it back on.
refused.note.account_mismatch: This email address belongs to a different Google account. Sign in with the account you used before, or ask your administrator for help.
admin.notAllowed: Only super admins can open the admin console.
companies.lead: Each company has its own database file and folder.
companies.empty: No companies yet. Create the first one.
newCompany.title: New company
newCompany.lead: Creates its folder and database. The first owner is invited by email.
newCompany.name: Company name
company.adminNote: Super admins manage people and invites here. Boards stay hidden unless you are a member of this company.
company.name: Company name
company.delete.title: Delete company
company.delete.lead: The folder and database move to trash and are kept for 30 days. After that they are removed for good.
deleteCompany.title: Delete {name}?
deleteCompany.lead: Its database and files move to trash for 30 days. Members lose access right away.
members.inviteHint: Email is not set up on this server, so share the site address with them yourself. When this person signs in with that Google account they join automatically. Workspace and personal Gmail addresses both work.
members.title: Members
members.none: No members yet. The first owner joins when they sign in.
invites.lead: Waiting for the person to sign in with Google.
projects.note: Super admins see project names, owners and counts only, never boards. Company owners manage projects and their owners.
audit.lead: Every admin action and every refused sign-in.
server.emailOff: Email is off. Invitations are shared by hand until email is set up in the server settings file.
switcher.label: Switch company
noAccess.title: Only company owners can open this page
companySettings.lead: {company} · you manage members and invites here as an owner
companySettings.storageHint: Files and the company database count towards the limit. A super admin can change it.
manage.lead: {company} · create, archive and delete projects, and choose their owners
manage.note: Boards stay private to each project. To look inside a project, add yourself to it. That is recorded in the audit log.
manage.empty: No projects yet. Create the first one.
noCompany.title: You are not in any company yet
noCompany.body: Ask a company owner to invite your Google account, then sign in again.
missingCompany.title: This company is not available
missingCompany.body: It may have been suspended or removed, or you are no longer a member.
toast.superOff: {name} is no longer a super admin
server.backupsHint: The nightly backup runs at 02:30 and keeps 30 days. The restore test restores the newest backup every Sunday and checks it.
projects.lead: {company} · you see the projects you belong to
projects.emptyTitle: You are not in a project yet
projects.emptyBody: Only company owners create projects, and project owners add people to them. Ask an owner of {company} to invite you.
project.missingBody: It may have been archived or deleted, or you are not a member of it.
project.boardsOwnersOnly: Only project owners can create boards in this project. A project owner can change this in project settings.
project.inviteHint: Email is not set up on this server, so share the site address with them yourself. When this person signs in with that Google account they get access. Someone who is not yet in {company} joins the company as a plain member and sees only this project. Workspace and personal Gmail addresses both work.
project.inviteOwnersOnly: Only project owners can invite people.
project.inviteOwnersOnlySwitch: Only project owners can invite people. Owners can allow members to invite in project settings.
project.name: Project name
project.membersCreateBoardsHint: When off, only project owners create boards.
project.membersInviteHint: When off, only project owners invite. Company owners can always add people.
project.archiveOwner: Only company owners can archive or delete a project. You can do this from Manage projects.
project.archiveAsk: Only company owners can archive or delete a project. Ask an owner of {company}.
manage.newLead: Only company owners create projects. Choose who will own it.
manage.addOwnerLead: Choose a company member. They become an owner of this project and can see its boards.
manage.deleteLead: Its boards and cards move to trash for 30 days, then are removed for good. Members lose access right away.
board.title: Board title
board.accessHint: Everyone in the project sees every board unless a board is restricted to chosen members.
board.restrictHint: Only the people checked below can open it.
board.wholeProjectNote: Everyone in the project has access.
board.missingBody: It may have been closed or restricted, or you are not in its project.
board.shareHint: Invite by email. They sign in with that Google account. Anyone not yet in the company joins as a plain member and sees only this project.
board.closedBanner: This board is closed. A project owner can reopen it from the project page.
board.observerBanner: You are an observer on this project. You can read everything but not make changes.
list.title: List title
boardMenu.title: Board menu
card.titlePlaceholder: Enter a title for this card
card.title: Card title
dnd.instructions: To pick up a card or list, press G. Use the arrow keys to move it, then G or Enter to drop it. Press Escape to cancel.
list.moveAll: Move all cards in this list
list.archiveAll: Archive all cards in this list
card.menuHint: Add to card, move, archive and more
card.itemMoveHint: Alt and the arrow keys move this item
card.commentPlaceholder: Write a comment. Type @ to mention someone.
cardPop.title: Title
editor.heading: Heading
editor.markdownHint: Write Markdown: **bold**, _italic_, - lists, [links](https://…). It replaces the description when saved.
search.title: Search
search.none: No cards match. Try fewer words.
search.label: label
filter.title: Filter cards
zen.on: Zen mode. Move to the top edge for controls. Press Z or Esc to leave.
keys.title: Keyboard shortcuts
keys.lead: Shortcuts act on the card you selected with the keys, or the one under the pointer. They are off while you type or while a menu is open.
keys.new: New card (in the selected card's list)
keys.label: Toggle a label by position
keys.drag: Pick up or drop a card or list, then move it with the arrow keys
keys.cardOpen: With a card open: next, previous, left and right card (arrow keys too in zen mode)
keys.item: On a checklist item: move it up or down
keys.escape: Close anything open, then clear the selection, then leave zen
settings.title: Settings
settings.lead: Personal settings for {name}. They follow you across companies.
settings.saveFailed: That setting could not be saved. Try again.
settings.name: Display name
settings.emailHint: Comes from your Google account and cannot be changed here.
settings.photoHint: People in your projects see this picture next to your name.
settings.zoomHint: Scales the whole app, dialogs included. Your browser zoom still works on top of this.
settings.zenOnHint: Stays on across boards until you turn it off.
settings.zenQuietHint: Hides pop-up messages while you work in zen mode.
settings.nowIs: It is now {now} in this time zone.
settings.sessionsLead: Sign out of anything you do not recognize.
settings.othersEnded: Signed out of all other sessions
settings.zenLead1: Hides the header so the board fills the window. Press
settings.zenLead4: to come back. Move the pointer to the top edge for controls.
live.title: Live updates
live.hint: Changes by other people appear on the board within a second.
attach.title: Attachments
attach.hintLimit: Files up to {max}. This company uses {used} of {limit}.
attach.tooLarge: Files can be up to {size}; this one is larger.
attach.badLink: Enter a link that starts with https://
cardPop.coverNoImages: Attach an image to use it as a cover.
notify.title: Notifications
notify.mention: mentioned you in a comment on
board.watching: You will be notified about new cards on this board
